accepted_reply_packets.purpose: IDENTIFY2 fixed-width version plus parameter-33 two-byte reply

notes: The CNI compressed common direct-packet prefixes on the second and third unit requests; expanded packets are recorded beside raw outbound lines.
The six parameter-35 bytes CE 4C B3 79 E7 9E decode to fixed-width TEST and native trims it in the 305 response.

bytecode_semantics.finding: NET PROJECT_IDENTIFY passes the supplied interface to the topology explorer in project-identify mode.

Project-identify mode creates and opens one temporary network, performs one installation MMI, reads CBusBaseNetwork project identity and UnitCount, then emits one 305 response; it does not traverse imported bridge topology.
UnitCount is every nonzero MMI state. Candidate scan is numeric, skips address zero, and returns the first unit that level-zero identification can create.
Level-zero discovery sends IDENTIFY2 and parameter-33 count 2 together and accepts an eight-byte fixed-width version plus two-byte reply.
Project identity recalls parameter 35 length 6 and exposes the decoded string.

cmqttd_boundaries: cmqttd reuses its one configured shared PCI/CNI and returns 502 for another otherwise-valid interface instead of opening a second connection.
The shared SRCHK-enabled connection sends checksummed requests and may send native combined operations as separately correlated frames; response semantics and source correlation are preserved.
PROJECT_IDENTIFY is read-only and does not populate or persist the imported project cache.
This scripted acceptance proves direct interface behavior only. It makes no routed, mutation, live-hardware, MQTT-broker or site-topology claim.
